g.text: A brief is parsed by a frozen deterministic parser back into an action distribution, then scored against the policy.

g.text: Per dimension KL is the only comparable form; summed KL sends every score to zero above about 16 actions.

g.text: Three fixes were tried and all were negative: wider conditioning, a differentiable contrastive objective, and 2.5 times
